name: ai-pack-project
title_zh: 六个技能打包上架，拆开各自能打
tagline_zh: 一个仓库装六件趁手工具，不凑数不灌水。装完先看目录再挑活，省得挨个翻 GitHub 找半天。
tagline_en: One repo, six ready-to-try skills. No filler, no fluff. Browse the index first, then pick your job — saves you.
why_zh: 合集的价值在编排：每个技能独立可用，但打包后能互相补位。适合想一次试多件、又懒得逐个调研的人。
why_en: The value is in curation: each skill works solo, but together they cover adjacent tasks. For tinkerers who want a taste of.
limit_zh: 只提供六个技能的集合与说明，不含任何技能本体代码；装完仍需按各自 README 单独配置依赖与环境。若你只缺其中一件。
limit_en: Contains only descriptions and links, no skill code. Each skill needs its own setup per README. Overkill if you need just one.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Six-pack of skills, each one stands alone
